exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.note: This one is for the days when your body is fine and your head is not. Work, travel, exams, a bad week. The movement here is short on purpose. You are not training, you are giving your attention somewhere to go before you ask it to sit still.

good: Slow. Let the breath lead and the spine follow
Out as you round, in as you arch
bad: Pushing into end range. Nothing here should feel like effort

good: On all fours, reach one arm under the other and let the shoulder settle
Then reach it up to the ceiling and open the chest
bad: Letting the hips drift away from over the knees

exercises.name: Open Book
exercises.note: A stressful day usually shows up in the same places: the upper back rounds, the shoulders creep up, the breathing moves into the chest. This opens the first one so the breathing has somewhere to go.

good: On your side, knees stacked, open the top arm and follow it with your eyes
Breathe out as you open. Do not rush back
bad: Letting the knees come apart so the hips do the turning

exercises.name: Box Breathing
exercises.note: Box breathing suits a busy head better than anything else here. The counting is the point: it occupies the part of you that wants to keep going over the day. Five minutes is the dose. If your mind wanders, notice it and go back to the count. That is the exercise, not a failure at it.

good: Sit upright somewhere comfortable, or lie down. Both work
In for four, hold four, out for four, hold four. All equal
Nose breathing throughout if you can
bad: Straining the holds. Drop to three counts if four is a fight
Doing it with the TV on

exercises.name: Child's Pose with Extended Exhale
exercises.note: Finishing with the long exhale rather than the box is deliberate. Box breathing steadies you. The long out-breath is what actually drops you down. Two minutes of it at the end is what you will feel walking away.

good: Knees wide, hips back to the heels, forehead down
In through the nose for four, out for eight
Let the shoulders get heavier on every exhale
bad: Getting up the second the timer goes. Take a few breaths before you move
